opinion.summary: Patch correctly fixes the obvious truncation (missing final segment) so public tests pass, but leaves the underlying rfind loop vulnerable to zero-progress hang and deletes the contract docstring. Not safe to merge as-is without a guard for end==0 (or end==0 handling) and preserving documentation.

hypotheses.note: Truncated AssertionError messages show test failure but do not by themselves prove contract vs example violation; support relies on unshown expected values, so evidence is weak not strong.

risks: Surviving infinite-loop/hang: when text segment starts with spaces and cols is small, rfind returns 0 -> end=0 -> line='' and text unchanged, while loop never terminates - original flaw not fixed.
Empty-input semantic change: unconditional lines.append(text) makes wrap('',cols) return [''] instead of [] (both concatenate to '' but differs from typical empty contract).
Documentation loss: patch deletes the Wrap Text contract docstring (even though unreachable after return) instead of moving/fixing it, removing spec from codebase.
